As the body ages, natural collagen levels decline, leading to reduced elasticity, wrinkles, and dryness. Calmerceuticals Premium Liquid Collagen is designed to combat these effects, targeting dull, tired-looking skin and visible signs of ageing.

Each serving contains 10,000mg of Type 1 hydrolysed marine collagen, clinically proven to improve skin elasticity and reduce wrinkles. Enriched with hyaluronic acid, Cultavit®, polyphenols, and essential vitamins C and D, it delivers deep hydration and supports optimal collagen performance within the body.

Crafted with the highest quality ingredients in Australian laboratories, Calmerceuticals ensures safety, efficacy, and superior results. A daily sachet helps rebuild and restore collagen levels, boosting your body’s natural collagen and hyaluronic acid production. Each box contains 14 ready-to-drink sachets for convenient, effective beauty support.

Ultra Performance works by activating the body’s core performance systems - hormonal, neurological, and cellular - to help men perform, recover, and thrive. Its adaptogenic and nutrient-rich complex supports healthy testosterone production, stabilises stress hormones, and optimises energy metabolism to maintain consistent drive, stamina, and mental focus throughout the day.

At the cellular level, it enhances mitochondrial efficiency for sustained energy output while reducing inflammation and oxidative stress that can slow recovery and performance. The dual collagen system promotes structural integrity in joints and skin, supporting strength and resilience from within.

Together, these mechanisms create a synergistic effect - improving how the body produces energy, regulates hormones, and recovers - empowering men to feel sharper, stronger, and more in control, every day.

Take one sachet daily, ideally in the morning or before training, to power strength, stamina, and focus throughout the day.
Tear open one sachet and mix it with 200 mL of water, or add it to your favourite drink, smoothie, or juice. Stir or shake well until fully dissolved and enjoy.
For best results, use consistently for 12 weeks to experience visible performance and vitality benefits.

Fermented Shilajit, L-Theanine, Maca Root Extract, Bovine Collagen, Hydrolysed Marine Collagen, Theobroma Cacao Seed Powder, Punica granatum (Pomegranate) Fruit Extract, Nettle Leaf Extract, Cultavit® B-Complex, Natural Blood Orange Powder, Fructooligosaccharides (Prebiotic Fibre), Buckwheat Seed Powder, Silica, Citric Acid, Davidson Plum Extract, Panax Ginseng Root Extract, Guarana Extract, Green Coffee Extract, Amaranth Extract, Aloe barbadensis Ferment, Thaumatin, Caffeine, Zinc Gluconate, Vitamin D3

settings.title: How long does it take to see results?
settings.text: Most men notice improved focus and energy within a few weeks. Clinically measured results on testosterone, stamina, and libido are typically seen after 12 weeks of consistent use.

settings.title: Can I take Ultra Performance with other supplements or pre-workouts?
settings.text: Yes - it’s designed to complement most daily vitamins and fitness supplements. If you’re on prescription medication or under medical supervision, consult your healthcare professional first.

settings.title: Is it safe for everyday use?
settings.text: Absolutely. Ultra Performance uses clinically validated ingredients at safe, effective doses and contains no synthetic hormones or banned substances.

settings.title: Who is Ultra Performance for?
settings.text: It’s made for men who want to increase energy, stamina, and mental focus, improve recovery, and support long-term performance and vitality - whether for the gym, work, or everyday life.

settings.title: What makes Ultra Performance different from other supplements?
settings.text: Unlike pills or injectables that target only one area, Ultra Performance is a precision-engineered vitality system. It works on a cellular level to support real biological change - improving testosterone balance, energy, focus, and recovery without synthetic hormones.

settings.title: Does Ultra Performance contain caffeine or stimulants?
settings.text: It includes a small amount of natural caffeine from green coffee and guarana extracts - enough to enhance focus and energy without jitters or crashes.
